jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(6)(C) inventory: Hartford Supervisory District -- the Hartford School District is a town school district and its own supervisory district (member town: Hartford).

sources.note: Hartford Board of School Directors minutes, March 4, 2026 (reorganization): 'Board Members present: Nancy Russell, Cathy Lemire, Jeremy Warren, Colin Butler, Daniel Schapira' -- Butler and Schapira welcomed as 'new Board Directors' under 'Oath of Office for Newly Elected Board Directors'. Term expirations are from the Town and School District Annual Report 2025 officials list (Russell 2027, Lemire 2028, Warren 2027) and the warned 2026 seat lengths (Butler's 3-year seat to 2029; Schapira's 2-year seat to 2028). The board is five directors at-large (16 V.S.A. section 423(a)-(b): three 3-year seats, two 2-year seats; the town's March 3, 2026 positions notice warned exactly one of each). Butler's official write-in tally was not fetched (missing: the Town Clerk's March 3, 2026 return of votes); his election is established by the minutes' 'newly elected' oath language (the district's 2025 precedent is Lemire's certified write-in win).

Hartford board resolution, June 3, 2026: 'Kevin "Coach" Christie has served on the Hartford Board of School Directors, as an Elected Member (March, 2007 - February, 2026).' His 3-year seat passed to Colin Butler at the March 3, 2026 election. Ended 2026.

Garrett Wilson held the 2-year seat expiring 2026 (Annual Report 2025 officials list); the seat passed to Daniel Schapira, the only filed candidate, at the March 3, 2026 election. Whether Wilson sought re-election is not stated. Ended 2026.
